'''2000 Origins Team Event''' was a Star Wars CCG team held in Origins, Columbus, Ohio on 14 July 2000. Anglo-Americans (team: [[Gary Carman]] and others) won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1018">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-17-origins-team-tournament-7-15-2000d1018/ origins-team-tournament-7-15-2000], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 17 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-17-origins-team-tournament-7-15-2000d1018/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027001633/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-17-origins-team-tournament-7-15-2000d1018/ Internet Archive].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 Origins Open]].

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' Anglo-Americans (team: [[Gary Carman]] and others)
